				AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE)  BETWEEN CORPORATE.SCD_Start_Date AND CORPORATE.SCD_End_Date

				AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN ('R', 'P')

                AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE)  BETWEEN MV_CITY.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_CITY.SCD_End_Date
            LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_STATE_DIM AS MV_STATE

                AND MV_STATE.BANK_ID = ADDRESS.BANK_ID
                AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE)  BETWEEN MV_STATE.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_STATE.SCD_End_Date
            LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_COUNTRY_DIM AS MV_COUNTRY
                ON MV_COUNTRY.[VALUE] = ADDRESS.[STATE]
                AND MV_COUNTRY.BANK_ID = ADDRESS.BANK_ID
                AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE)  BETWEEN MV_COUNTRY.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_COUNTRY.SCD_End_Date
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT EDA.CUST_ID,EDA.BANK_ID FROM
						EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
						INNER JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
							ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
							AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
							AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
						INNER JOIN EDS.BOB_TBLACCOUNT EBT
							ON EBT.NO = EDF.FORACID
							AND EBT.BNK_CODE = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
							AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EBT.SCD_START_DATE AND EBT.SCD_END_DATE
						WHERE @process_date = EDA.AS_OF_DATE
						UNION 
						SELECT EDA.CUST_ID,EDA.BANK_ID FROM
						EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN EDA
						INNER JOIN EDS.LOAN_FACT EDF
							ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
							AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
							AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
						INNER JOIN EDS.BOB_TBLACCOUNT EBT
							ON EBT.NO = EDF.FORACID
							AND EBT.BNK_CODE = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
							AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EBT.SCD_START_DATE AND EBT.SCD_END_DATE
						WHERE @process_date = EDA.AS_OF_DATE
						) BOB_LKP
				ON BOB_LKP.CUST_ID=CUST.CORE_CUST_ID
				AND BOB_LKP.BANK_ID=CUST.BANK_ID	
            WHERE CUST.H = 'D';
